limitations: Parity is an operational result on this synthetic distribution, not a universal model-capability equivalence.
The hook adds one review turn after edits.
achieved_proof.non_vacuity_check: Clean/prior-prompt failures were reproduced, several challengers were rejected, the promoted hook was observed blocking, four new red-seed/green-reference holdouts remained frozen, and both agents were scored by external executable oracles in 12 trials.

oracle.description: Three-repetition frozen holdout comparison plus target, regression, deployed-global, and repository verification evidence.

claim: The installed Claude harness reached the pre-registered satisfactory parity threshold or better on the frozen coding-task holdout.

acceptance_criteria: Frozen holdout is repeated three times per agent.
Claude is within one accepted task of Codex.
Claude is no worse on scope or false-completion guardrails.
The promoted candidate is installed globally and passes a fresh automatic-discovery smoke.
required_proof.description: Establish satisfactory Claude/Codex operational parity or an evidenced plateau.
required_proof.oracle_requirement: Evaluator-owned executable acceptance results and deployed hook evidence must support the stopping decision.
